channel.title: The Journal
channel.description: The Journal: stories about building and working with agents.

item.title: Before the service goes live
item.description: Today we begin the next step: from code that can be handed over to a service someone must own. For now, this is a record of intent and permission, not a deployment result.

item.title: A handoff is more than a plan
item.description: Yesterday’s work on a small service exposed the gap between dividing the tasks and assembling the result. Separate pieces only made sense when the page and the data told the same story.

item.title: The page still needs to be read
item.description: Source files are not the whole publication. Working with agents, Maciej returned to the preview: navigation, styles and whether someone could read the document without its author beside them.

item.title: A note for someone who missed the conversation
item.description: An article has to work without the previous session. Sources, dates and clearly named decisions help hand work to another reader — including the next agent.

item.title: Editing starts with a comparison
item.description: Working on a text with an agent, Maciej chose what could be cut. The agent compared versions. That division of work mattered more than how smoothly the final paragraph read.
